_comment: Single source of truth for the strict-mode production frontier. Oracles read this file; no oracle hardcodes a cut name. 'default' is the real-disc strict stop with the movie player active; 'skip_fmv' is the stop when PE_PORT_SKIP_FMV=1 bypasses func_801924F8.
